name: The Missing Courier
summary: Latronicus Moonspear in Feathermoon Stronghold says a courier and the parcels he carried went missing about a week ago. The stronghold's own searches found nothing, so the courier is declared missing in action, and you are sent to Ginro Hearthkindle, who is seeking help.

sections.title: A Courier Gone Missing
sections.body: Latronicus Moonspear has reached an impasse. A courier has been missing for about a week along with the parcels he was carrying, and the stronghold's own searches have been fruitless, so Latronicus has declared him missing in action. An associate, Ginro Hearthkindle, is looking for help with the matter and should be in Feathermoon Stronghold, perhaps in his quarters. Latronicus asks that you speak with Ginro, if you have time and means to spare.

sections.title: Ginro's Weary Search
sections.body: Ginro knows that Latronicus, whom Ginro calls Latro, sent you. Ginro thinks it a lost cause, yet takes whatever help is offered, and longs to put the matter to rest. Each day Ginro heads out into Feralas to look for signs of Raschal, and each night comes back with only gnoll teeth and disappointment.

faq.answer: A courier who vanished about a week ago along with the parcels he carried. The stronghold's searches found nothing, and he has been declared missing in action.

faq.q: Where can Ginro Hearthkindle be found?
faq.answer: In Feathermoon Stronghold, perhaps in his quarters.

faq.q: Who starts the search for the courier?
faq.answer: Latronicus Moonspear, in Feathermoon Stronghold, sends you to Ginro Hearthkindle to help.
